ephemeral.description: true if running in an ephemeral environment

name.description: This is the name of the environment or hostname

email.description: Email is the email address associated with the group (e.g., a mailing list).

id.description: ID is the unique identifier for the group.

name.description: Name is the human-readable name of the group.

parent.description: Parent is the ID of the parent group, if any.

group.description:
Group contains the group details if this identity represents a group.
Will be nil if this identity represents a user.

id.description:
ID is the unique identifier for this identity. This will most likely be an email for users
or a group name for groups. This will be used to tie identities across providers.

label.description: Label is a human-readable name or description for this identity.

providers.description:
The providers this identity is associated with
Format is map[provider_name]provider_type

tenant.description:
Tenant represents the tenant or organization this identity belongs to.
This is useful for multi-tenant systems where identities are scoped to specific tenants.

user.description:
User contains the user details if this identity represents a user.
Will be nil if this identity represents a group.

endpoint.description: Optional endpoint associated with the session

Endpoint specifies the OTLP endpoint for remote logging.
The structure of model.Endpoint may include fields such as URL, protocol, and authentication.
Example YAML:
  endpoint:
    url: "https://otel-collector.example.com:4317"
    protocol: "grpc"
    auth:
      type: "basic"
      username: "user"
      password: "pass"
Refer to serverlessworkflow/sdk-go/model.Endpoint documentation for full details.

email.description: Email is the user's email address, often used as a primary identifier.

groups.description: Groups is a list of group names or IDs that this user belongs to.

id.description: ID is the unique identifier for the user.

name.description: Name is the user's full display name.

source.description: Source identifies the identity provider or system where this user originated.

username.description: Username is the user's login name or handle.

verified.description: Verified indicates whether the user's identity has been verified.

approved.description: nil = pending approval, true = approved, false = denied

name.description: SearchAttributes are the custom search attributes associated with the workflow

from.description: Runtime expression to extract the correlation value

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the error.

instance.description:
A JSON Pointer used to reference the component the error originates from.
Runtimes MUST set the property when raising or escalating the error. Otherwise ignore.

status.description:
The status code generated by the origin for this occurrence of the error.
For cross-compatibility concerns, it is strongly recommended to use HTTP Status Codes whenever possible.
Runtimes MUST ensure that the property has been set when raising or escalating the error.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the error.

type.description:
A URI reference that identifies the error type.
For cross-compatibility concerns, it is strongly recommended to use Standard Error Types whenever possible.
Runtimes MUST ensure that the property has been set when raising or escalating the error.

time.description: ISO 8601 date-time string or runtime expression

token.description: Token The security token to use

type.description: Type The type of the security token to use.

after.description: After The duration after which to timeout

authenticator.description: Which provider to use for authentication

identities.description: Optional identities to elevate, if empty the requesting user is used

providers.description: A role can be applied to multiple providers

tenants.description: Optional tenant IDs for multi-account providers

capabilities.description: Allows the user to specify what this provider can do

role.description: The base role for this provider

authenticators.description: All the auth providers that the role can use. If empty then any provider can be used

groups.description: groups to add the user to

inherits.description: roles to inherit from or provider specific roles/policies etc

providers.description: providers that can assign this role

resources.description: resource access rules, apis, files, systems etc

scopes.description: scope of who can be assigned this role

provider.description: Provider ID to set as default

sessions.description: Map of provider name to session

disableVersioning.description: DisableVersioning disables worker versioning/deployments for testing
